Hi Jenna — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifications from Finance: 

1) Legal entity verification
- The vendor name on the W-9 must match the legal name we enter in the vendor master. If Brightline Materials, Inc. is correct, we'll proceed.

2) ACH / Wire requirements
- For ACH we need the signed ACH authorization form plus either a voided check or bank letterhead confirming account ownership. For wires, please include SWIFT and intermediary bank details if applicable.

3) PO routing / invoice fields
- Redwood PO format: RW-###### (we'll create the PO and include it in the email to your invoices@ address). Please include the PO number and our tax ID (visible on the PO) on the invoice for auto-apply.
- Payment terms default to Net30 unless otherwise agreed — if you need earlier terms, flag it now.

4) Next steps / timeline
- Evelyn will upload the intake form to the vendor record once we receive the final ACH docs.
- Finance will complete vendor master creation within 3 business days of receiving the bank letterhead + signed ACH.

I've attached a short checklist (Vendor-setup-checklist.xlsx) for your AP team which maps each required doc to the intake field. Let me know if any of the fields are a blocker.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
